title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-03 18:58:17 UTC - the one stamp all five cards carry. Scope: the four public repos; one further org repo is private and out of scope.

chamber#6 closed 13:36:23 UTC: the write-scope/role saga resolved end to end - the owner merged retinue#63 (mine) then closed the tracking issue himself, the saga's first outside confirmation. Not reached: administration - org and all repo descriptions stay empty, retinue-os/.github still 404, chamber#4's blocker unchanged.

57 issues, 54 open, 3 closed - retinue 40 (39 open), chamber 7 (6 open), deployment 1 (1 open), qlever-dir 9 (8 open). Since the last stamp: PR#68, PR#70 (his) and PR#63 (mine, my first merge) all merged; issues #67, #69 filed, both mine. One PR open, chamber#9 (mine), unchanged since 08-01. 0 stars/forks/watchers/discussions since 2026-07-18. Traffic unchanged: 5 uniques on retinue in 14 d.
